figs.name: pid-controller-series-to-ideal-conversion-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to convert series PID tuning to ideal ISA form with sample values
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to convert series PID tuning to ideal form using the standard relations, with a sample of Kp 2, τi 4 min and τd 1 min.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to convert series PID settings to ideal form with a sample calculation</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#3730a3" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Convert Series PID Settings to Ideal Form</text>
<rect x="210" y="58" width="380" height="62" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="83.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Read legacy series settings</text>
<text x="400.0" y="106.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">sample: Kp 2, τi 4 min, τd 1 min</text>
<line x1="400" y1="120" x2="400" y2="138" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,138.0 510.0,180 400,222.0 290.0,180" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="186.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">τd = 0?</text>
<line x1="510" y1="180" x2="560" y2="180" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="534" y="170" font-size="17" fill="#16a34a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="560" y="146" width="220" height="68" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="670.0" y="174.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PI loop: copy</text>
<text x="670.0" y="197.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">values, no retune</text>
<line x1="400" y1="222" x2="400" y2="244" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="416" y="238" font-size="17" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="90" y="246" width="360" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="270.0" y="282.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Kp ideal = Kp × (1 + τd/τi)</text>
<line x1="452" y1="277" x2="488" y2="277" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="490" y="246" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="283.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2 × (1 + 1/4) = 2.5</text>
<line x1="270" y1="308" x2="270" y2="332" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="90" y="334" width="360" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="270.0" y="370.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">τi ideal = τi + τd</text>
<line x1="452" y1="365" x2="488" y2="365" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="490" y="334" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="371.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 + 1 = 5 min</text>
<line x1="270" y1="396" x2="270" y2="420" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="90" y="422" width="360" height="62" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="270.0" y="458.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">τd ideal = (τi × τd) ÷ (τi + τd)</text>
<line x1="452" y1="453" x2="488" y2="453" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="490" y="422" width="250" height="62" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="615.0" y="459.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">(4 × 1) ÷ 5 = 0.8 min</text>
<line x1="270" y1="484" x2="270" y2="504" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="90" y="506" width="650" height="60" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="415.0" y="542.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Enter Kp 2.5, τi 5 min, τd 0.8 min in the ideal controller</text>
</svg>
